units.source_text: 两位女公子相貌都长得很好，以美人著名于时，故恋慕之人甚多。

en.t: The two young ladies were both very beautiful, renowned in their day as beauties, and so they had many admirers.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣家的公子，称为藏人少将的——是正夫人云居雁所生，官位比诸兄高，父母特别疼爱他，是个品貌兼优的贵公子——也热诚地向玉鬘夫人的大女公子求爱。

en.t: A son of Minister of the Right Yugiri, the young man called the Kurodo no Shosho, was born to the principal wife Kumoinokari; his rank was higher than that of his brothers, his parents cherished him especially, and he was a noble young gentleman blessed with both looks and character. He too ardently courted Lady Tamakazura's eldest daughter.

units.source_text: 此人无论从父亲或母亲方面来说，都与玉鬘有不可分离的亲密关系。

en.t: Whether through his father or through his mother, this young man had close and inseparable ties with Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 因此他和弟兄们常在髭黑大臣邸内出入，玉鬘夫人对他们都很亲昵。

en.t: For that reason, he and his brothers often came and went at Minister Higekuro's residence, and Lady Tamakazura was very affectionate toward them all.

units.source_text: 这藏人少将和她家的侍女们也很熟悉，颇有机会向她们诉说自己的心事。

en.t: This Kurodo no Shosho was also well acquainted with the women serving in her household, and he had many chances to confide his feelings to them.

units.source_text: 因此众侍女日日夜夜在玉鬘夫人耳边赞扬藏人少将，玉鬘夫人不胜其烦，又很可怜他。

en.t: So the serving women praised the Kurodo no Shosho in Lady Tamakazura's ear day and night, until she was thoroughly wearied by it, though she also felt sorry for him.

units.source_text: 他的母亲云居雁夫人也常常写信给玉鬘夫人，代他请求。

en.t: His mother, Lady Kumoinokari, also often wrote to Lady Tamakazura, pleading on his behalf.

units.source_text: 父亲夕雾大臣也对玉鬘夫人说：“他的官位还低，但请看我们面上，允许他吧。”

en.t: His father, Minister Yugiri, also said to Lady Tamakazura, "His rank is still low, but for our sake, please grant him permission."

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人已有决心：大女公子必须入宫，不嫁臣下。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura had already made up her mind: her eldest daughter must enter the palace and would not marry a subject.

units.source_text: 至于二女公子，只要藏人少将官位稍高，配得上她家时，不妨许嫁与他。

en.t: As for her second daughter, once the Kurodo no Shosho's rank rose a little and he became a suitable match for her family, she saw no harm in allowing the marriage.

units.source_text: 藏人少将则怀着可怕的念头：如果玉鬘不允许，要将女公子抢走。

en.t: The Kurodo no Shosho, however, harbored a frightening thought: if Tamakazura would not consent, he would carry the young lady off by force.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人并不十分反对这件亲事，但念我方尚未正式允许之前，如果发生意外之事，则传闻于世，被人讥议，名誉攸关。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura was not strongly opposed to the match, but she thought that if anything improper happened before her side had formally given permission, the story would spread through society, people would criticize them, and their honor would be at stake.

units.source_text: 因此叮嘱传递信件的侍女们：“你们必须当心，谨防发生错乱！”

en.t: Therefore she warned the serving women who carried the letters, "You must be careful and guard against any confusion or mishap!"

units.source_text: 侍女们都提心吊胆，觉得难于应付。

en.t: The serving women were all on edge and felt that the matter was difficult to manage.
